page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute and media workloads requiring dedicated hardware acceleration. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via KVM virtualization, it features 32 dedicated vCPUs along with 128 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio (4.0 GB per core).

Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA P4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 16 GB VRAM. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data needs. Network throughput is capped at a 6 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The inclusion of dual NVIDIA P4 accelerators paired with moderate memory density makes this instance efficient for low-latency deep learning inference, image processing, and media video transcoding tasks. A major operational tradeoff is the total reliance on external storage arrays due to the absence of local disks. It provides an efficient resource footprint for targeted GPU inference workloads without requiring higher-end enterprise training hardware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for media processing and machine learning inference workloads. Running on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it incorporates 32 dedicated vCPUs, 128 GB of RAM (4 GB per vCPU), and dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs supplying 16 GB of VRAM total. The system operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and includes no bundled local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage volumes. Without built-in ephemeral storage, storage performance depends on external block storage attachment. The pairing of 32 compute cores with two NVIDIA P4 GPUs provides an efficient hardware allocation for video transcoding, image recognition, real-time AI inference, and graphic rendering tasks that benefit from hardware acceleration without requiring heavy training-class GPU clusters.
